=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:2125-2159 (`_mt_merge_lease_tick`), 2408-2433 (`_mt_merge_lease_tick_multi`) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In both tick variants, any ineligible candidate with a soft skip entry goes down the skip-held branch (`tick_first_soft` / `tm_first_soft`) even when `MERGE_LEASE_GATE_CONFIRMED=true`, which `_merge_lease_pr_eligible` sets on a head-gate `success` before it returns ineligible for reasons such as `final_ci_failed`.
  WHY: Contrary to G5, such a waiter keeps `ai:merge-lease-wait` and its skip entry, logs `reason=skip_head_unchanged` instead of the real reason, counts as skip-held for D4, is checked again on every tick (taking one of the 10 candidate slots), and in the multi tick is not added to `_MT_LEASE_QUEUE_GONE`. The fix is to add `&& [ "${MERGE_LEASE_GATE_CONFIRMED:-false}" != "true" ]` to the soft branch. All reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:2713-2718, 2780, 2810, 1881-1887 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_mt_release` seeds the lease tick's active-run cache and sets `_MT_LEASE_RUNS_SEEDED=1` before its loop dispatches `<workflow> [pr:<n>]` review runs (line 2780), and the tick at line 2810 reuses that pre-dispatch listing instead of listing again.
  WHY: A lease holder whose review this pass just dispatched shows no active run in `_mt_lease_pr_runs_active`, so it is revoked (`revoked_idle` / `revoked_no_head_gate`, with a hard skip entry for idle). This reintroduces the G1/G2 failure. The suggested fix is `[ "${released}" -eq 0 ] || _MT_LEASE_RUNS_SEEDED=""`, or treating the dispatched PRs as active. Severity MAJOR from all three.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:2713-2718 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `_mt_release` sets `_MT_LEASE_RUNS_SEEDED=1` even when the listing call returns non-zero (incomplete, e.g. a `mktemp` failure), so the cache stays "failed" and the tick never makes a fresh listing pass in that invocation.
  WHY: Gemini says this can lead to premature revocation of holders that have live runs. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised the same root cause only as a hardening suggestion: they say it fails open (holders stay "unknown") and delays revocations rather than causing premature ones. The suggested fix is `[ "${_MT_LEASE_RUNS_STATE}" = "ok" ] && _MT_LEASE_RUNS_SEEDED=1`.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:2713-2720, 1883-1887 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: If `mktemp` fails, the command-substitution fallback runs `_mt_inflight_review_branches` in a subshell, so its raw-run cache never reaches the caller and `_MT_LEASE_RUNS_SEEDED` is not set.
  WHY: The lease tick then lists active runs a second time, which breaks the one-listing-pass-per-tick API budget on this fallback path. This contradicts the gemini finding above, which says the flag IS set on this path, so the two are kept separate.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:904-909, 2630-2640 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_merge_lease_wedged_queued_seconds` emits a `::warning::` for an invalid `ZOMBIE_RUN_MAX_QUEUED_HOURS` on every call, and `_pr_head_ci_runs_pending` calls it on every invocation, including from non-lease poll loops (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1157, 1211; scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1849).
  WHY: The result is repeated warning spam in unrelated workflow logs; behavior stays fail-open, with a fallback to 24 hours. All three rated it NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disputes it: line 904 calls the helper with `2>/dev/null`, so the warning never reaches the log. Sonnet instead suggests, as hardening, that the warning is silently suppressed on every lease path.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:`_mt_release`, lines 2713-2718 (`_mt_inflight_review_branches > "${release_listing_file}" && release_listing_rc=0` ... `_mt_lease_runs_seed "${release_listing_rc}"` and `_MT_LEASE_RUNS_SEEDED=1`), then line 2780 (`if _mt_dispatch_review "${num}" "${head}"; then`), then line 2810 (`_mt_merge_lease_tick "${prs_json}" "${base_filter}" || true`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The lease tick reuses the active-run listing that `_mt_release` reads before its loop dispatches the `[pr:<n>]` review runs. The cache therefore predates every dispatch made at line 2780.
  WHY: A holder that is `ai:merge-queued`, is past the idle time or head-gate grace, and gets its review dispatched in this pass is revoked (`revoked_idle` / `revoked_no_head_gate`, hard-parked for idle). This defeats G1/G2 of #9983. Fix: `[ "${released}" -eq 0 ] || _MT_LEASE_RUNS_SEEDED=""` before line 2810, or treat the PRs in `release_released_prs` as active.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:`_mt_merge_lease_tick` candidate loop, lines 2143-2156; same logic in `_mt_merge_lease_tick_multi` | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The soft skip-held branch fires for an ineligible candidate even when `MERGE_LEASE_GATE_CONFIRMED=true`, which `_merge_lease_pr_eligible` (`scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh` lines 3306 and 3371) sets before it returns `final_ci_failed`.
  WHY: This violates G5. The waiter keeps its label, logs `skip_head_unchanged` and is counted as skip-held for D4. It is also checked again on every tick, so it can push eligible waiters out of the 10-candidate cap. Fix: add `&& [ "${MERGE_LEASE_GATE_CONFIRMED:-false}" != "true" ]` to the soft branch in both ticks.
- HARDENING: scripts/review_merge_train.sh `_mt_release`, line 2718 (`_MT_LEASE_RUNS_SEEDED=1`)
  PROBLEM: The flag is set even when the seed stored `failed`, so the tick holds past-idle holders as unknown and does not list again. This fails open but holds off revocations.
  WHY: Fix: `[ "${_MT_LEASE_RUNS_STATE}" = "ok" ] && _MT_LEASE_RUNS_SEEDED=1` (1 line).
- HARDENING: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh `_pr_head_ci_runs_pending` line 904 and scripts/review_merge_train.sh `_mt_lease_pr_runs_active` (`lra_wedged="$(_merge_lease_wedged_queued_seconds 2>/dev/null)"`)
  PROBLEM: Both call sites send the helper's stderr to `/dev/null`, so an invalid `ZOMBIE_RUN_MAX_QUEUED_HOURS` silently falls back to 24 hours and the documented `::warning::` never appears.
  WHY: Fix: keep stderr on one call site per process, or log a single warning from the tick when the value does not match `^[1-9][0-9]{0,5}$` (2-3 lines).
- NOTE: Sonnet dropped a pass-1 finding about repeated `::warning::` lines because line 904 uses `2>/dev/null`. Task gaps: NONE. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:_mt_merge_lease_tick candidate loop (around lines 2125-2159 in the last_run_diff.patch) and _mt_merge_lease_tick_multi candidate loop (around lines 2408-2433 in the last_run_diff.patch) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Both ticks treat every ineligible soft-entry candidate as skip-held even when `MERGE_LEASE_GATE_CONFIRMED` is `true`, so candidates failing other checks (CI failing, draft, `[skip ai]`) are not handled as normal ineligible waiters, contrary to G5.
  WHY: Such a candidate keeps its `ai:merge-lease-wait` label and its `skip=<pr>:<head>:revoked_no_head_gate` entry, logs `skip_head_unchanged`, and never takes the normal ineligible path. Fix: add `&& [ "${MERGE_LEASE_GATE_CONFIRMED:-false}" != "true" ]`. No test covers this; `test_no_head_gate_skip_entry_clears_once_the_head_gate_succeeds` only covers the passing-CI case.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:_pr_head_ci_runs_pending (around lines 905-909 in the last_run_diff.patch), _merge_lease_wedged_queued_seconds (around lines 2630-2640) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The invalid-`ZOMBIE_RUN_MAX_QUEUED_HOURS` `::warning::` fires on every `_pr_head_ci_runs_pending` call, including from non-lease poll loops (near lines 1157 and 1211, and `scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1849`).
  WHY: This spams logs in unrelated workflow runs; behavior stays fail-open, so it is hygiene only.
- HARDENING: scripts/review_merge_train.sh `_mt_release`, around lines 2713-2721
  PROBLEM: `_MT_LEASE_RUNS_SEEDED=1` is set unconditionally even when the seed left `_MT_LEASE_RUNS_STATE="failed"`, so the tick skips its own listing pass and treats every holder as unknown.
  WHY: Fix: `[ "${_MT_LEASE_RUNS_STATE}" = "ok" ] && _MT_LEASE_RUNS_SEEDED=1` (1 line).
- HARDENING: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh `_merge_lease_wedged_queued_seconds`, around lines 2630-2640 (called from _pr_head_ci_runs_pending at lines 905-909)
  PROBLEM: The warning fires on every call.
  WHY: Fix: memoize the result in `${_MERGE_LEASE_WEDGED_CACHED_SECONDS}` / `${_MERGE_LEASE_WEDGED_CACHED_HOURS}` (about 4 lines).
- NOTE: Task gaps: NONE; minimax lists every G1-G6 deliverable as present in the diff. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
